follow-up time: Until delivery, up to 72 hours after induction
exposure: Induction of labor with a balloon catheter and misoprostol
Induction of labor with dinoprostone and misoprostol
induction of labour by means of a balloon catheter
outcome: Rate of primary Caesarean sections due to failed induction of labor
cohort: 521 women undergoing induction of labor at term at the University of Erlangen Perinatal Centre in 2012 (n=230) and 2013 (n=291)
finding: Routine use of a balloon catheter for induction of labor reduced the rate of failed inductions, primary Caesarean sections due to failed induction, observation of green amniotic fluid, and infantile infections.
mod_finding: The use of a balloon catheter for induction of labor resulted in fewer failed labor inductions and fewer Cesarean sections due to failed induction of labor.
